buddy.detail.writeHint: I ka nimɔrɔ bɛ to gundo la.
buddy.detail.endBody: Mɔgɔ bɛ kunnafoni WhatsApp kan, ɲɔgɔnye wɛrɛ si tɛna labɛn.
buddy.detail.reportIntro: Fila-fila bɛ jɔ o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ, koordinatɛri dɔ bɛ i ka kɔrɔsili kalan.

more.appointments: Taa ni mɔgɔ ye ɲɔgɔnye la, formulaire fa ɲɔgɔn fɛ
appt.title: Ɲɔgɔnyew
appt.intro: Mɔgɔw bɛ a ɲini WhatsApp kan mɔgɔ dɔ ka taa n'u ye (préfecture, OFII, dɔgɔtɔrɔso…) walima ka u dɛmɛ ka formulaire fa (CAF, ANEF, AME). I bɛ a dɔn a ye jɔn ye, ni i sɔnna dɔrɔn.
appt.noTime: Lɛrɛ min ka kan ka di
appt.acceptBody: Mɔgɔ bɛna i tɔgɔ fɔlɔ, lɛrɛ ani ɲɔgɔnye yɔrɔ sɔrɔ WhatsApp kan, a ka kan na. I b'a dɛmɛ a ka faamu ka fa: sariya laadilikan tɛ. I yɛrɛ ka nimɔrɔ kana di.
appt.meetingPointHint: Misali: da kunba la, miniti 15 ɲɛ
appt.calendar: A fara n ka kalandiriye kan
appt.documentsBody: Mɔgɔ sɔnna i ka u ye nin ɲɔgɔnye dɔrɔn kama. Dayɛlɛli bɛɛ bɛ sɛbɛn. Donni bɛ ban don kelen ɲɔgɔnye kɔfɛ.
appt.releaseBody: Mɔgɔ bɛna kunnafoni, ɲinini bɛna bɛnɛwɔli wɛrɛw makɔnɔ tugun.
appt.cancelBody: Mɔgɔ bɛna kunnafoni WhatsApp kan. Ɲinini tɛna di tugun.
appt.emptySub.open: Ɲininiw bɛ se yan ni mɔgɔ dɔ ye “8” sugandi WhatsApp menu kɔnɔ.
appt.empty.all: Ɲɔgɔnye si ma kɛ kalo 3 labanw kɔnɔ.
appt.error.taken: Mɔgɔ dɔ sɔnna nin ɲɔgɔnye ma ka ban.
appt.error.booked: Nin lɛrɛ tara: ɲɔgɔnye segin o nɔ na.
appt.slots.title: Lɛrɛ dɔ di
appt.slots.intro: Walasa ka formulaire fa ni mɔgɔ dɔ ye. Mɔgɔw bɛ lɛrɛ lankolon nataw ye WhatsApp kan ka kelen ta.
appt.slots.placeHint: Misali: tɔn ka biro, walima “telefɔni fɛ”

home.appointments.desc: Ka taa ni mɔgɔ ye walima formulaire dɛmɛ ɲininiw, u bɛ ka makɔnɔ.

perm.appointments.slots: A yɛrɛ ka lɛrɛw di formulairew kama

more.numbers: Nimɔrɔ minnu anti-spam ye u minɛ, nimɔrɔ datugulenw
num.title: Nimɔrɔ minɛnenw
num.intro: Anti-spam bɛ nimɔrɔ minɛ ni a ye cikan caman kojugu ci. A ka cikanw tɛ ɲɛnabɔ fo i ka latigɛ ta. A lajɛ sani i ka a datugu: mɔgɔ min bɛ gɛlɛya la, o fana bɛ se ka sɛbɛnni caman kɛ.
num.floodMode: Cikan caman bɛ ka na: nimɔrɔ kuraw ka cikan fɔlɔw bɛ minɛ. Mɔgɔ minnu bɛ dɛmɛ ka ban, olu bɛ dɛmɛ i n'a fɔ tuma bɛɛ.
num.known: Mɔgɔ dɔ min bɛ dɛmɛ ka ban
num.blockBody: Cikan si tɛna ɲɛnabɔ nin nimɔrɔ fɛ tugun, an tɛna foyi ci a ma, hali hakilijiginw. I bɛ se ka a da wuli kɔfɛ.
conv.guardHeld: Anti-spam ye nin nimɔrɔ minɛ: a ka cikan kuraw tɛ ɲɛnabɔ.
conv.guardBlocked: Nin nimɔrɔ datugura: a ka cikanw tɛ jate.
login.code: Kode min bɛ i ka authentification application kɔnɔ
login.codeHint: Jateden 6, u bɛ yɛlɛma sekɔni 30 o sekɔni 30.
login.codeWrong: Nin kode tɛ baara kɛ. A nɔfɛta makɔnɔ ka a lajɛ tugun.
login.locked: Lajɛli caman kojugu. A lajɛ tugun miniti {n} kɔfɛ.
signup.tooMany: Ɲinini caman waati surun kɔnɔ. A lajɛ tugun kɔfɛ.
signup.doneTextEmail: An ye imɛli ci i ma: lien min bɛ a kɔnɔ, o da wuli walasa ka i ka adresi dafa. O kɔfɛ koordinatɛri dɔ bɛna sɔn i ka kɔnti ma.
verify.title: Imɛli adresi dafara
verify.text: I ni ce. Koordinatɛri dɔ bɛna i ka ɲinini lajɛ sisan. I bɛ se ka don ni a sɔnna dɔrɔn.
tfa.title: Authentification sen fila la
tfa.on: A bɛ baara la: donni bɛ kode ɲini i ka application fɛ.
tfa.off: I ka kɔnti tanga ni kode jateden 6 ye gundosɛbɛn kan.
tfa.required: A wajibiyalen don administrateur josariyaw kama (bɛnɛwɔliw, musakaw, donni sɛbɛn…).
tfa.banner: I ka administrateur josariyaw jɔra fo authentification sen fila la ka daminɛ.
tfa.step1: Authentification application dɔ don (Aegis, FreeOTP, Google Authenticator…).
tfa.step2: Nin kode scanner, walima butɔn digi nin telefɔni kan, o kɔfɛ kode min bɛ jira, o sɛbɛn.
tfa.manual: Walima nin kilee sɛbɛn ni bolo ye:
vol.emailUnverifiedHint: Nin mɔgɔ ma a ka imɛli kɔnɔ lien digi fɔlɔ. I bɛ se ka ɲinini sɔn o kɔfɛ.
vol.reset2fa: Authentification sen fila la kɛ kokura
vol.reset2faBody: A kɛ ni mɔgɔ ye a ka telefɔni tunun. A bɛ bɔ yɔrɔ bɛɛ, a ka kan ka application kura labɛn. A lajɛ fɔlɔ a ye jɔn ye (welekan, ɲɔgɔnye).
sandbox.location: Yɔrɔ ci (i ta, walima Paris République ni a banna)
places.notLocatedHelp: Adresi ma sɔrɔ kariti kan: yɔrɔ bɛ to don lisi kɔnɔ, nka a tɛ di mɔgɔ minnu bɛ u ka yɔrɔ tila. Adresi lajɛ (nimɔrɔ, sira, dugu).
more.associations: Tɔnw dilan ka u ka administrateurw sugandi
assoc.title: Tɔnw
assoc.intro: Tɔn kelen-kelen bɛɛ ni a ka administrateurw don: u bɛ u ka bɛnɛwɔliw ka tɔgɔsɛbɛnw sɔn, u bɛ se ka u wele ni lien ye.
assoc.createHelp: A ɲini jamana ka sɛbɛn kɔnɔ walasa tɔgɔsɛbɛn minnu bɛ a sugandi, olu ka se a ka administrateurw ma.
assoc.name: Tɔn tɔgɔ
assoc.exists: Nin tɔn bɛ Wilson kɔnɔ ka ban.
assoc.noAdmin: Administrateur si tɛ fɔlɔ: ɲininiw bɛ taa Wilson ka administrateurw fɛ.
assoc.addAdminHelp: Mɔgɔ bɛ don tɔn in kɔnɔ. A bɛ se ka tɔgɔsɛbɛnw sɔn, ka bɛnɛwɔliw wele ani ka u ka josariyaw labɛn, nin tɔn dɔrɔn kama.
assoc.removeAdminBody: {name} bɛ to {association} tɔnden ye nka a tɛ se ka sɔn walima ka wele tugun. A ka session datugura.

join.intro: {name} ye i wele. I ka kɔnti bɛ baara la ni a dilanna dɔrɔn.
join.introNoAssociation: I welela ka don Wilson kɔnɔ. I ka kɔnti bɛ baara la ni a dilanna dɔrɔn.
join.invalid: Nin welekan lien tɛ baara kɛ tugun (a kɛra, a dabilara walima a waati banna). I bɛ se ka ɲinini ci hali bi.
join.doneText: Don ni i ka imɛli ni gundosɛbɛn ye.
inv.title: Bɛnɛwɔli wele
inv.intro: Lien min bɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen, a bɛ baara kɛ tile 7. Mɔgɔ bɛ don {name} kɔnɔ k'a sɔrɔ a ma sɔnni makɔnɔ.
inv.introGlobal: Lien min bɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen, a bɛ baara kɛ tile 7. Mɔgɔ bɛ kɔnti sɔrɔ min bɛ baara la k'a sɔrɔ a ma sɔnni makɔnɔ.
inv.label: A ye jɔn ye?
inv.readyBody: A ci mɔgɔ ma i yɛrɛ ma (WhatsApp, SMS, imɛli). A bɛ jira siɲɛ kelen dɔrɔn: a kopi sisan.
inv.shareText: Don {name} fɛ Wilson kan walasa ka mɔgɔ minnu bɛ dɛmɛ, olu dɛmɛ:
inv.emptySub: Lien dilan ni “Wele” ye ka a ci mɔgɔ ma.
